label: LoadDeviceState
info:
Reads Load Device State from registers:
- 526-528: Energy (daily + total)
- 640-646: UPS power low + Load voltage
- 650-655: Load power low + frequency
- 656-659: Load power high
- 696-699: UPS power high

Triggers:
1. RPC: getLoadDeviceState

name: Route to 5 reads
Prepare read (Energy 526-528)
Prepare read (UPS/Voltage 640-646)
Prepare read (Load/Freq 650-655)
Prepare read (Load High 656-659)
Prepare read (UPS High 696-699)
Build LoadDeviceState JSON
Prepare RPC Response
RPC Trigger Only (getLoadDeviceState) - 5 parallel reads, 32-bit power
